batting.name: MA Agarwal
batting.dismissal: c SR Tendulkar b JJ Bumrah

batting.name: DT Christian
batting.dismissal: c MG Johnson b Harbhajan Singh

batting.name: RT Ponting
batting.dismissal: st KB Arun Karthik b M Kartik

batting.name: SR Tendulkar
batting.dismissal: run out (JD Unadkat, KB Arun Karthik)

batting.name: KD Karthik
batting.dismissal: c MA Agarwal b R Vinay Kumar

balls.text: ends the innings with a six! 92 for Gayle, Munaf errs by bowling it too full and wide outside off, Gayle was forward and across, made room and slashed it over deep point
nearly carries all the way! This was full and wide outside off and Gayle makes room and throwns his bat at it, the outside edge clears short third man and nearly goes for six
makes room and the ball clips the pads and rolls away
gets away with a low full toss as he pushes it down to long-off
finds that gap so easily! Too full and straight and Gayle stays deep at the crease and flicks it away easily and beats two fielders at deep midwicket
this was really wide outside off and he can only bash it straight to cover, dot ball that too
good delivery to end the over, on the blockhole and he digs it out to the leg side
low full toss and he slams it down to long-on, Kohli wants more fours and yes, he still has his pads on
good delivery, a bit too full and he can only drill it to long-on
full on middle and worked to the on side
Karthik playing a useful hand here, this was full and Karthik went forward and whipped it across the line, in the air and bisects two fielders in the deep on the on side
down the leg side and he tries to work it away
this was fractionally short and he stays back and flat-bats it over long-on, raw power
full and wide outside off and there were two fielders at point and yet he managed to carve it above them, unstoppable
Dropped  but a good attempt at the rebound by Ponting! Karthik tries to clear extra cover, Ponting leaps, fails to hang on, back flips and tries to take the rebound, nearly...
another low full toss and he leans forward and bashes it to deep extra cover
full tosses to Gayle don't help, this was a low full toss moving away and he stayed put and carved it wide of backward point, not the prettiest shot
fullish outside off and he gets forward and drills it down to deep cover
he gets forward and mistimes the drive down to mid-off, Gayle's still struggling to get to the other side
short of a length and he goes for the slog and misses
goes for the slash and ends up getting an inside edge that drops short of Dinesh Karthik
8 off the over already, this was sliding down the leg side and Karthik manages to clip it off his pads wide of his namesake Karthik
karthik goes over the on side this time, Oram bowls it full on middle and leg and he heaves it down to deep midwicket
ends the over and his spell with a yorker, Gayle did well to dig it out
down the leg side and close to kissing the edge
stays back and pushes it back to the bowler
just flew off the bat, Gayle made room early, Harbhajan tossed it wide outside off and he carved it flat over deep cover
cuts him straight to point
fuller delivery and he chases that and the ball sneaks under the bat
this was short and wide outside off and Arun Karthik hops at the crease and carves it over point
moves away and he opens the face of the bat and steers it to third man
short of a length and moves away, he pokes at it and is beaten
full and wide outside the off stump and he drives wide of cover
fullish outside the of stump and he pushes it towards cover
fires that full and wide outside off, too wide
the extra ball (there was a wide) costs Mumbai a boundary, drifts on the pads and flighted, he clips it forcefully down to deep midwicket
comes forward and gets a leading edge to the off side
streaky way to get to a fifty, an inside edge past the stumps
he pays for bowling a fast full toss on the pads, bludgeoned away down to deep square leg
bowls it straight, keeps it straight and Gayle is happy defending
fires it down the leg side and wide called
flatter delivery and he defends this one
this was full and wide outside off and simply thrashed to deep extra cover
full on the pads and he tucks it to the on side, Gayle's struggling with his running

Ponting's punt on Bumrah's working! He's picked up three tonight, very similar to Kohli's dismissal, delivers from wide of the crease, sharp inward angle, struck on the pads and the umpire gave him out on a second
on the pads and he works it to the on side
fullish and angling away and he quietly pushes it to the off side
flat! This was fractionally short and he sits back and clears the front leg and whacks it down to deep midwicket, the umpire confirms that it just fell short of the rope
straighter one and he punches it to cover
flatter delivery and works it to midwicket
Harbhajan tosses it up and Christian went forward and looked to chip it over midwicket, ended up timing it too well and found Johnson at the deep
drops it a bit short and he goes back and cuts to deep point
tossed up and he gets forward and defends
nips back in and gets an inside edge to the pads
that was a tennis backhand slice! Low full toss and sliced down the ground one-handed
this was short and he stays back and pulls to deep midwicket, Johnson runs from deep square leg, gets a hand to it but parries it to the boundary
95 meters! Over the second tier! It was full and Gayle made room, cleared the front leg and teed off over wide long-on, awesome
fluke boundary for Gayle as he tries to help it to the on side and gets a leading edge past point for four, it was in the air
he risks padding up and Pollard went up in appeal, didn't offer a shot, pitched on leg and hitting him above the knee roll, that wasn't hitting

we have a collision and Gayle's in pain, Christian chips it in the air and Harbhajan goes to his right to catch it, collides with Gayle, the big man's down, clutching his left leg, Harbhajan tries to help him up
makes room and pushes it wide of point
shuffles early and he tucks it with the angle to fine leg
slower through the air and he's beaten, Karthik knocks down the stumps
quicker delivery and Christian was forward early to drive
flat delivery to begin with and he chops it to the off side, mistimed really
this was shorter and he pulls on one leg to the on side
take that! Slower one and Gayle clears the front leg and hits it straight and flat down to the sightscreen
nicely timed! This was drifting on the pads and he shuffles and tucks it wide of square leg, this outfield is quick
this time Gayle decides to give it a whack but he's beaten for pace, good bounce as well, close to the edge
Gayle still quiet, fullish on the stumps and pushes it to mid-off
tries to punch it to the off side and he gets an inside edge past the stumps
wrong line, down the leg side and he shuffles and easily tucks it wide of the keeper
tucks it to the on side
mild excitement there, bounced and hit Gayle high on the thigh pad before going to the keeper, Karthik thought he edged it
tries to work it across the line and he places it wide of mid-on
this time he slides it down the leg side
example of the seam movement again, nipped back in and beat the bat, Karthik had some work to do
stays back and the ball bounces a bit more and beats the bat
oh dear shoddy fielding by the senior man Harbhajan! On the pads and he tucks it off his pads to fine leg, Harbhajan had it covered but the ball slipped between his legs on the dive
angles it from wide of the crease and Gayle softly pushes it to mid-off
angles it towards the pads and he tucks it to the on side
Christian gets across and pushes it to the off side
fullish in length outside off and he pushes it to the off side

Bumrah's in the action again! Poor shot by Agarwal, he stood at the crease and tried to slam it over mid-off, he needed more elevation, mistimed it and Sachin took it well in front of the circle at mid-off
Gayle's still his 'usual' watchful self, this was on the stumps and quietly pushed towards cover
stays back and he works it away to the on side
knocks it towards mid-on and risks a single and Agarwal was lucky Rayudu';s throw was way off target
this one jags back in and nearly takes out the off stump, that was close
tucks it away towards mid-on and tells his partner to wait
Gayle decides to slash at that and see where it goes, it was in the air but down to third man
loosener down the leg side, Gayle lets it go
stays back and he defends back to the bowler

he gets a wicket would you believe it! He delivers from really wide of the crease and gets a sharp inward angle, Kohli was forward and struck on the pads and in front of the stumps, Bumrah belts out a victory cry, if only we could hear it though
three fours in four balls! He is having a nightmare here, giving width to Kohli, he just frees his arms and slams it over cover, Kohli's having a net
some respite for the bowler, closer to the off stump and he pushes it to the off side
poor ball, same result, this was not as short and wide but still good enough for Kohli to slice it along the ground wide of cover
welcome to the IPL Mr Bumrah! Short and wide outside off, Kohli had a lot of width to work with, slammed that over cover, unusual action though
stays back and tucks it with the line down to fine leg
good comeback by Munaf, that was a jaffa outside off, Kohli was poking forward and the ball just seamed away, Karthik thought there was an edge
wow! Can we have the ball back please? Kohli just danced down the track and slammed this over the second tier over wide long-on
moves towards middle and he quietly tucks it to the on side
really restrictive line here, on the off stump and Kohli can't do much but play it back to the bowler
stays behind the line and he pushes it back to the bowler
Gayle's in no hurry yet, he's happy to leave this one outside off
this was sprayed wide outside off and wide called
stays beside the line and steers it to backward point, he slides and they sneak in a run
stays back at the crease and defends this one
not a bad start at all for the new skip! Good length on the pads and he stylishly whips it wide of square leg, Oram does his best to chase and slide but the ball just about beats him

timber! The off  stump is down, Johnson bowls this one fuller and it goes through straight, Dilshan tries to whip it away to the on side and leaves a massive gap between pad and bat, the off stump is thrown sideways and lands a few yards back
nice running, Gayle half heartedly tapped it to the off side and Dilshan was off quickly, they take the run easily
bowls a tight line there, not much room and he steers it to the off side
shows the full face  of the bat nicely and pushes it back to the bowler
this was fuller and he really thudded this one down to mid-off, off the middle of the bat
Dilshan goes for the wild slash and misses, Munaf tempted him with width
drifts on the pads and he shuffles and tucks it down to midwicket
lands it outside off and moves away, doesn't offer a shot
he pushes it towards cover and sets off and there's hesitation, they decide against it
this was fuller and he went forward and pushed it towards mid-on
Mitchell where were you? That was a beauty of a delivery, sliced Dilshan in half and the ball just sailed over the stumps, phew
first runs off the pad, quietly tucked away down to square leg
Gayle doesn't do anything with this one, moves away and doesn't offer a shot
almost a strike! At first it looked like he edged it, it swung away from middle, squared him up on the off stump, hit the pad and good attempt by keeper Karthik

Vinay holds his nerve and bowls a yorker! All Pollard can do it drill it down to long-on, Vinay stretched his arms in deliht as soon as Pollard played the shot because he knew there was no way that was going for four

well he's bashed a four! It was a low full toss and he made room and smashed it over the bowler, it was dead straight, appeared to fall on the rope on the half volley, the umpire signalled a four but then decided to check again. From one angle it looked like it bounced just before the rope so a four it is
no hat-trick for Vinay but it will only be a single to deep midwicket, Harbhajan swings and gives Pollard the strike

Vinay knocks down the off stump and he has taken two in two! Vinay gets the ball to nip back in, Rayudu was deep in the crease looking to cut, he was cramped for room and the ball crashed onto the off stump and sent it back by a few yards

Karthik's fighting knock comes to an end! He tries to club a length delivery over the on side, gets high on him and it results in a top edge, Agarwal runs forward from deep midwicket and takes the skier

beats him first ball as he tries to force it through the off side, they try to sneak in a bye, Arun K's under-arm throw misses the stumps, Vinay picks up and dives, he hits the stumps but Karthik's home
bowls a full delivery and he pushes it down to long-off
yet another collision! Makes room and bashes it down to long-off, Rayudu and Arun K collide as the batsman tries to make his ground
short of a length outside off and he pulls it down to deep midwicket
Karthik gets a life! Rayudu mistimed the pull along the track and Karthik was backing up a long way, Unadkat has a shy at the bowler's end but misses and it's an overthrow
this is short and wide and he carves this one down to third man, falls short of the fielder
stays back and slaps that in the air over point
down the track and he's beaten in flight and the ball clips his pad and rolls away
tossed up and worked away down to midwicket
works it to deep square leg and it brings up the fifty stand
he's not done yet! Tossed up and Karthik gets on his knee and slogs him clean over deep midwicket
full outside off and pushed to cover and it's his fifty! One over here has changed everything
if things can't get worse for the bowler he now bowls a full toss above the waist! Karthik laps it up by clubbing it down to deep square leg
three in a row! Karthik's turning it on! This was a length delivery and Karthik swings and gets enough to clear the keeper and the boundary at fine leg, where are the yorkers?
we're used to seeing Christian slaughtered in the death overs! This was pitched up on middle and leg and he lofts him high over long-on
that was clean! This was short and down the leg side and Karthik swivels and pulls high and far over fine leg, timed really well
fuller delivery and he tries to slog and misses
flat-bats it to the bowler and  Karthik gets a hand to it but drops it, the ball deflected to the on side and the bowler seemed rather annoyed
tossed up and he comes down the track and he works it down to long-on
sweeps him down to deep square leg, Agarwal picks up
down the track and he lofts him over cover and down to long-off
streaky! He chips down the track and gets an inside edge the beats the stumps, the keeper and runs away
chips down the track and clears midwicket and it drops short of Kartik at deep midwicket
tries to hoick this one down to midwicket, the ball hits his body and rolls to the keeper
drifts on the pads and he works it to fine leg
short outside off and he pushes it to deep point

ouch! Karthik gets hit on the pad and tries to pinch a run, Rayudu was off the blocks, Christian tries to underarm the throw to the stumps, Rayudu collides with Arun Karthik and it seems as if the keeper was hit on the head, he is ok now
moves a long way across his stumps and he's struck on the pads and there's an appeal, can't give that out because it hitting him outside the line
he opens the face of the bat and runs it down to third man and Kartik does well to stop it
this was short and Rayudu arches backward and carves it towards third man, the ball dips and falls short of Kartik
he swings and misses! Vinay Kumar keeps it straight, Rohit tries to swipe it across the line and he misses it completely, the off stump is pushed back
this time he goes over the on side, lofts over midwicket and the fielder picks up in the deep
tucks him up for room and he steers it down to point
stays deep at the crease and punches it towards mid-on
opens the face and steers it with the angle to third man
this square cut was just as good by karthik, he follows the angle of the ball and slices it wide of point and the fielder slides but can't stop it
angles across him and he gets an outside edge to third man
shot! Rohit at his best, this was short and angling across and he whiplashed that wide of Dilshan at backward point, it was there before you knew it
he chips down the track and checks his shot, glides it down to third man
just short of a length and he shapes to cut but misses
flatter delivery and he works it down to square leg
tossed up and he gets on his knee and  mows it down to square leg
flatter delivery and he pushes it to cover
low full toss and he clips it down to long-on
tossed up and he chips down the track and whips it to square leg
gets on the front foot and drives to long-on
tries to cut but gets an inside edge
flighted outside off and driven down to long-on
comes forward and pushes a full delivery to cover
goes back at the crease and punches it down to long-on
the reverse sweep! Tossed up outside off and he gets in position early and forces it wide of short third man
quicker delivery and he pushes it to backward point

Appeal for a stumping and Arun Karthik is absolutely sure he has got him! And he has! Tossed up on middle and leg and Ponting makes room to force it through but misses, tries to drag his back foot back but Karthik's reaction was too good for him, the third umpire takes a look. The two legends are back in the pavilion now
beats him as he tries to force it away to the off side and Karthik whips off the bails
on the back foot and worked down to midwicket
tossed up down the leg side he shapes to sweep, fails to make contact, well fielded by Unadkat
tossed up and he rocks back and punches it wide of point
tucks it down to short midwicket
short outside off and he punches it to deep backward point
tossed up and he gets down to sweep but outside the line of the off stump
tossed up and he works it to deep square leg
clips it towards midwicket and Kohli fails to stop it properly, Kohli doesn't have his pads on, we can assure you
tossed up and he comes forward and pushes it back to the bowler
tries to sweep him and fails to make proper contact
stays back and he cuts really hard down to deep backward point

Appeal for a run-out! He works it down to short fine leg and sets off and Ponting sends him back, the throw from Unadkat is to the keeper's end and Karthik whips off the bails and He has been given out! It was touch and go, extremely close, the third umpire was convinced the bails were off the groove before the batsman could make the crease
tossed up and he drives him down to mid-off
makes a lot of room and cuts wide of backward point, good work by Nair in the deep to cut that off
fullish on middle and leg and worked to long-on
these two are looking dangerous! Ponting too gets a long way across the stumps, picks a full delivery from outside off and whips it in the other direction wide of deep square leg
shuffles a long way across to the off stump and stylishly whips it away down to deep square leg
Tendulkar stands and delivers, pitched up delivery on the off stump and he lofts through the line well wide of mid-off
keeps it tight, tucks him up for room and he can only work it to midwicket
this was full on middle and leg and he works it down to long-on
two out of two, tossed up and he chips it high over midwicket, one bounce and four
bang! Can't get it straighter than that, tossed up and he makes room, clears the front leg and smacks it over the bowler and umpire, tremendous bat speed
gets forward and across and pushes it to the off side
goes for the sweep again but this was hitting outside the line of off, he was a long way across
tossed up and he gets on his knee and sweeps wide of sort fine leg
stays back and pushes it to the off side
stands tall and times the punch well past extra cover, finds the gap and two fielders chase, good coordination by the two fielders, ends of a good over
showing some signs of urgency, tries to slash one outside off and misses
goes deep into his crease and pushes a full delivery down to extra cover, something's got to give here
chips down the track and he slices it in the air down to third man
full and moving away from him and he pushes it towards cover, can't find the gap
moves a long way across his stumps and angles it down to third man
steers it towards backward point and there's a direct hit at the bowler's end and they take a singe off the deflection
comes down the pitch and pushes a full delivery to mid-on
class! Ponting gives Christian the charge, it was a length ball and Ponting slammed it over long-on and the cheer girls had to run for cover
this was pitched up and he drives on the up towards mid-off
Ponting fetches this one from wide outside off and pulls along the ground wide of midwicket
down the track and he chips it over cover, Ponting wanted the third run and Sachin was more than happy with two, had to send him back
short on the middle stump and he pushes it down to short midwicket
finally a boundary! Poor delivery short down the leg side and tendulkar helps it on its way wide of the keeper and down to fine leg
risky single there, gets an inside edge to the on side and Ponting had to hurry
moves across and the ball clips his pads and deflects towards slip, hesitation in the running there
he comes down the track again and he ends up forcing it down to mid-on
exaggerated shuffle by Ponting as the ball clips his pads, Unadkat appeals confidently
this was well timed but straight to backward point, just 3 off the first two overs
he works it away towards mid-on and risks the single, the fielder has a shy at the bowler's end
Ponting walks down the pitch and he ends up steering it straight to backward point
good length on the off stump, doesn't give him room, he defends
keeps it outside the off stump and he moves across and shoulders arms
gets forward and pushes it towards mid-off
driven on the up towards cover
the good length ball nips back into Tendulkar, who defends awkwardly, the ball falls at his feet and Ponting sprints through. They are quick, for a couple of 'old' men
Tendulkar comes forward to hi first ball and drives a full one towards mid off
Ponting strides across his stumps and pushes the ball off his pads in front of square leg
good length, pitching in line and slanting across Ponting, who strides forward and shoulders arms
short of a length and down the leg side. Ponting jumped across to glance but missed
